interface.description: A pure interface: public abstract operations, attributes only as constants (static, read only).

abstract.description: An abstract class: no instances of its own; subclasses complete it.

value-object.description: A value: final, private read-only attributes, query operations only; setters are reported.

entity.description: An entity: stereotyped entity, identified by a read-only id attribute.

enum.description: An enumeration: final, attributes read only.

static-utility.description: A utility class: final, static members only, a private constructor so it is never instantiated.

immutable.description: An immutable class: final, read-only attributes, query operations only; setters are reported.
